note: Belt-and-suspenders luminos containment at chartWrap. The .tg-luminos-layer already had overflow:hidden but the sprites carry will-change:transform which creates a stacking context that can render past the inner parent's overflow boundary in some browser builds. Adding overflow:hidden to .chart-canvas-wrap clips anything that escapes the layer. One-line CSS fix caught by Opus from a chair-test screenshot showing a sprite visible between the main chart and the sub-charts.
